title: Business Trip Itinerary for Laura Green
paragraphs: Business Trip Itinerary for Laura Green
Monday, September 14: Flight 205 departs at 7:30 in the morning. Boarding begins at gate 12, about 40 minutes before departure. Please arrive at the airport at least two hours early.

Arrival at the destination is at 10:45 in the morning. A taxi will take you to the hotel near the convention center. Checkin time is usually 2:00 in the afternoon, but the front desk will keep your luggage if you arrive early.
At 1:00 in the afternoon, attend the sales conference at the convention center. The full schedule and room number are listed in the printed itinerary you received last week.
Friday, September 18: Checkout from the hotel by 11:00 in the morning, then taxi to the airport for the return flight.
